description: React component for displaying and managing team approvals in a time-tracking system. It renders a list of pending submissions, allows for approval or requesting changes, and includes placeholder logic for data fetching.

methods.name: ManagerApprovals()
methods.description: React functional component that manages and displays pending approval submissions for a manager.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Asynchronous function inside useEffect hook to simulate data fetching of pending submissions.

methods.name: onApprove
methods.description: Handles approval action for a submission, removing it from the pending list.

methods.name: onRequestChanges
methods.description: Handles 'request changes' action, removing the submission from the pending list.
